title: Speaker attitude drill: Planning a farewell potluck
context: You will hear two friends from work talking about a farewell potluck for a coworker who is moving away.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Ben! Okay, I've got an idea. Jun's last day is the twentieth, right? Let's do a potluck for her. Something small, just the old team.

segments.speaker: Ben
segments.text: A potluck. Hmm. You mean, like, at someone's place?

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Well, I was kind of hoping yours. You've got that big balcony.

segments.speaker: Ben
segments.text: Big is generous. And, I mean, I'm not saying no, but you remember the last one, right? Twelve people, and nine of them brought chips.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Ha, okay, that was bad. But this time I'll make a sign-up sheet. Mains, salads, desserts. Nobody gets to pick chips.

segments.speaker: Ben
segments.text: A sign-up sheet. Okay, that's actually not a terrible idea.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: See? And I'll come over early to help set up, and I'll stay to clean.

segments.speaker: Ben
segments.text: You say that every time, Ana.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: And this time I mean it! Come on, it's Jun. She covered your shifts for, like, two weeks when your dad was in the hospital.

segments.speaker: Ben
segments.text: Yeah, I know. I know. She did. Okay, fine. But Saturday afternoon, not evening. My building's strict about noise after ten, and I don't want another warning from strata.

segments.speaker: Ben
segments.text: Three's fine. And I'm making my mom's spring rolls, so nobody else bring spring rolls.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Deal. I'll send the sheet out tonight.

questions.prompt: How does Ben first respond to the idea of hosting the potluck?

options.text: He is excited and offers his balcony right away.
options.whyVi: Chính Ana đề nghị dùng ban công; Ben còn đùa 'Big is generous'.

options.text: He refuses because his apartment is too small.
options.whyVi: Ben có đùa là ban công không lớn ('Big is generous'), nhưng anh nói 'I'm not saying no' – anh không từ chối.

options.text: He is hesitant, though he doesn't reject it outright.
options.whyVi: Đúng: 'I'm not saying no, but...' – ngần ngại nhưng chưa từ chối.

options.text: He is angry that Ana didn't ask him earlier.
options.whyVi: Ben không tỏ ra giận dữ.

questions.evidence: I'm not saying no, but you remember the last one, right?
questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc 'I'm not saying no, but...' thể hiện sự miễn cưỡng nhưng còn để ngỏ. 'Not rejecting it outright' = 'not saying no'.

questions.prompt: What is Ben's opinion of the sign-up sheet?

options.text: He admits, a little reluctantly, that it is a good idea.
options.whyVi: Đúng: 'that's actually not a terrible idea' – cách khen gián tiếp, miễn cưỡng.

options.text: He thinks it is a terrible idea.
options.whyVi: Có từ 'terrible' nhưng Ben nói 'NOT a terrible idea' – nghĩa là ý hay.

options.text: He thinks people will still bring chips.
options.whyVi: Ana nói danh sách sẽ ngăn việc mang khoai tây chiên; Ben không phản bác.

options.text: He wants to make the list himself.
options.whyVi: Ana là người sẽ làm và gửi danh sách.

questions.evidence: Okay, that's actually not a terrible idea.
questions.explanationVi: 'Not a terrible idea' là cách nói giảm (understatement) = khá hay. Từ 'actually' cho thấy anh hơi bất ngờ khi đồng ý.

questions.prompt: What does Ben mean when he says, "You say that every time"?

options.text: He is thankful that Ana always helps him.
options.whyVi: Câu này mang ý nghi ngờ, không phải cảm ơn.

options.text: He doubts that Ana will really stay to clean up.
options.whyVi: Đúng: Ana hứa ở lại dọn dẹp, và Ben ngụ ý lần nào cô cũng hứa vậy mà không làm.

options.text: He wants Ana to arrive earlier than usual.
options.whyVi: Ana nói 'come over early' nhưng Ben không yêu cầu đến sớm hơn.

options.text: He is tired of Ana planning parties.
options.whyVi: Ben chỉ nghi ngờ lời hứa dọn dẹp, không phải chán chuyện tổ chức tiệc.

questions.evidence: You say that every time, Ana.
questions.explanationVi: Câu trả lời của Ana 'And this time I mean it!' xác nhận Ben đang nghi ngờ lời hứa của cô. Cần hiểu ý ngầm, không hiểu theo nghĩa đen.

questions.prompt: What finally persuades Ben to host?

options.text: Ana's promise to help him clean.
options.whyVi: Ben vẫn còn nghi ngờ sau lời hứa này; anh chỉ đồng ý sau khi nghe nhắc tới Jun.

options.text: Being reminded that Jun supported him during a difficult time.
options.whyVi: Đúng: Jun đã làm thay ca cho anh khi bố anh nằm viện; ngay sau đó Ben nói 'Okay, fine'.

options.text: Learning that the strata has changed its noise rules.
options.whyVi: Quy định tiếng ồn không đổi; đó là lý do anh muốn tổ chức buổi chiều.

options.text: Being allowed to make his mother's spring rolls.
options.whyVi: Chả giò được nhắc sau khi Ben đã đồng ý.

questions.evidence: She covered your shifts for, like, two weeks when your dad was in the hospital.
questions.explanationVi: Ben đáp 'Yeah, I know. I know. She did. Okay, fine.' ngay sau câu này. 'Covered your shifts when your dad was in the hospital' = 'supported him during a difficult time'.

vocabulary.vi: tiệc mỗi người mang một món
vocabulary.definition: a meal where each guest brings a dish to share
vocabulary.example: Let's have a potluck for Jun's last day.

vocabulary.definition: a list where people write their names to choose a task or item
vocabulary.example: I'll make a sign-up sheet so nobody brings chips.

vocabulary.definition: to work in place of a coworker
vocabulary.example: She covered my shifts when my dad was sick.

vocabulary.definition: a phrase used to show doubt without refusing
vocabulary.example: I'm not saying no, but my place is tiny.

vocabulary.vi: nói quá lên, hào phóng (khi khen)
vocabulary.definition: here, describing something more kindly than it deserves
vocabulary.example: Calling my balcony big is generous.

vocabulary.definition: an informal way to say you agree to an arrangement

review.notes: Blind-solved all 4 Qs; key matched. 3/4 speaker_attitude (meets drill target). Changed: Q1 option B trap tag too_broad -> partially_true with whyVi explaining the 'Big is generous' hint.
